source_evidence_statements: scripts/evaluate_feedback_control_ml.py trains a class-balanced logistic howl-risk detector on SMARD configuration 0000 and evaluates held-out configurations 1000 and 2000 with exact seven-feature extraction and 97-point threshold selection.
The pinned source controller uses 2-frame persistence, -3 dB per detection event, a -12 dB floor and slow recovery; this fixture keeps those rules exactly with the public v0 frame size of 160.
This evidence uses deterministic synthetic paths instead of AMI/SMARD audio and does not reproduce the source report numbers.
